name: gaffer
description: A personal SDLC toolbox for Claude Code: issue drafting, review and confirmation; build, verify and raise-pr stages that end on a machine-readable verdict; a verified pull-request review with follow-up rounds; whole-codebase and dead-code audits; and a hook that keeps unattended runs from stalling on chmod. A repository extends the plugin's default CONVENTIONS.md and REVIEW.md with files of its own.
